description: Aider-polyglot style (Kotlin, hard): implement an immutable zipper over a binary tree (left, right, up, setValue, setLeft, setRight, focusTree, replace, toTree). The hard parts are rebuilding the parent on up() without losing the sibling, keeping everything immutable, and structural equality that depends on both the whole tree and the focus position, with a consistent hashCode, so a round trip down and up compares equal to the start. A plain Kotlin test runner compiled by run_tests.py is the acceptance bar and the post-turn verifier runs it for a repair round.
